CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsBinary

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns YES if the value is a binary object, such as the result of ToBinary or a file read with CFFILE ACTION="ReadBinary".

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsBinary(value)

Parameters

value
Any value.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

A Base64 string is not binary: it is ordinary text until you convert it with ToBinary. Binary values cannot be output directly; convert them with ToBase64 or ToString first.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "KoldFusion">
<CFSET Encoded = ToBase64(Text)>
<CFSET Bin = ToBinary(Encoded)>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Value</TH><TH>IsBinary</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>"#Text#"</TD><TD>#IsBinary(Text)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToBase64: "#Encoded#"</TD><TD>#IsBinary(Encoded)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToBinary(that)</TD><TD>#IsBinary(Bin)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ToString(that): "#ToString(Bin)#"</TD><TD>#IsBinary(ToString(Bin))#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

ToBinary, ToBase64, ToString, IsSimpleValue
